map.输入基本额定动载荷 C、当量动载荷 P、转速 n，计算 L10 基本额定寿命（百: Enter the basic dynamic load rating C, equivalent dynamic load P and speed n to compute the L10 basic rating life (in million revolutions and hours)
map.📖 查看「轴承载荷寿命选型 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Bearing Load and Life Selection Guide"
map.L10 寿命为可靠度 90% 时的额定寿命，即 10% 失效概率: The L10 life is the rating life at 90% reliability, i.e. a 10% failure probability
map.当量动载荷 P 需根据径向/轴向载荷组合按 P=XFr+YFa 计算: The equivalent dynamic load P is computed from the radial/axial load combination as P=XFr+YFa
map.不同可靠度寿命需引入可靠度系数 a1 修正（Lna=a1·L10）: Lives at other reliabilities require the reliability factor a1 (Lna=a1·L10)
map.一般机械轴承要求寿命 10000~20000h，重型机械可达 50000h 以上: General machinery bearings require a life of 10000-20000 h, and heavy machinery can reach over 50000 h
map.📚 深度解析：滚动轴承额定寿命: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Rolling Bearing Rating Life
map.L10=(C/P)^p 百万转（球 p=3、滚子 p=10/3）。: L10=(C/P)^p million revolutions (ball p=3, roller p=10/3).
map.C=60 kN、P=10 kN、n=1500 rpm：L10=(60/10)^3: C=60 kN, P=10 kN, n=1500 rpm: L10=(60/10)^3=216 million revolutions; L10h=1e6×216/(60×1500)=2400 h. If P=15 kN: L10=(4)^3=64 million revolutions, L10h=711 h; a 50% load increase reduces the life by about 70%.
map.同一批轴承 90% 可达或超越的寿命（百万转），即 10% 在此之前失效，是额定: The life (in million revolutions) reached or exceeded by 90% of a bearing batch, i.e. 10% fail before it; it is a rating, not a guaranteed value.
map.当量动载荷 P 怎么来？: How is the equivalent dynamic load P obtained?
map.由实际径向/轴向载荷与载荷系数合成 X·Fr+Y·Fa，再乘冲击系数，详见轴承样: Combine the actual radial/axial loads with the load factors as X·Fr+Y·Fa, then multiply by the impact factor; see the bearing catalogue for details.
map.轴承载荷寿命选型计算器，根据轴承基本额定动载荷 C、当量动载荷 P 与转速 n，: A bearing load and life selection calculator: from the basic dynamic load rating C, equivalent dynamic load P and speed n it computes the L10 basic rating life (in million revolutions and hours), supporting ball and roller bearings, aiding bearing selection.
map.球轴承/滚子轴承双模式: Dual mode for ball / roller bearings
